latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Sales Call Plan-Do-Review Coach skill.

- Supports two modes: Pre-Call (consolidates SPIN question bank and Advance objective into a 5-minute call brief) and Post-Call (applies Rackham's seven review questions to your call notes for a detailed debrief).
- Enforces a closed learning loop by tying each call review to the next call's plan.
- Requires inputs like deal briefs, question banks, and call notes/transcripts.
- Surfaces the detail-oriented review habits of top performers, avoiding vague feedback.
- Not for generating SPIN questions or Advance objectives (use linked skills for those tasks).
